decisions: Paid-ad longevity could not be verified: Meta Ad Library returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch and Google Ads Transparency Center returned no extractable ad data. No ad-longevity claim is made anywhere in the product.
Market evidence is limited to live marketplace pricing and public practitioner reports, recorded in docs/research-dossier.md with source type labels.
Differentiation is deterministic tooling plus measurable before/after token counts, not a prompt list, because generic skill bundles are commoditized at $2-$19.
Token counts are documented as characters/4 estimates to avoid tokenizer-precision claims.
unresolved: Owner approval for commercial terms, pricing, support, and publication.
Behavioral activation test in a named client (Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, Codex).
Run on Node 18/20/22 and on Windows before advertising those environments.
evidence: Expected outputs regenerated from the scripts, not hand-written.
Structural and functional tests run from the product root.
